discription: A warm detuned saw wave pad with a low-pass filter, offering a smooth, sustained sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.5, 0.7, 1.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Mix.new([ Saw.ar(freq), Saw.ar(freq * 1.005), Saw.ar(freq * 0.995) ]); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
